checks.details: Nine exception rows and 24 pass names occur in the request; disjoint union equals the sealed v8 control file 33 top-level test functions. Expected messages and prefixes match.

Only one terminal empty split component is removed. Header scan excludes last line; section end excludes final summary. This avoids the prior summary misclassification. Extra summaries, invalid totals or unsupported final categories reject; warning(s) are recorded only.

One failure section per expected name; first matching traceback entry requires exact path and full test name. E-prefixed lines must form a nonempty contiguous block; first E line must decode as exception type/message. Chained exceptions and RED unexpected-cause marker reject. Predicted line equality is INFO only.

Started/timed_out/runner_ok use exact booleans; cleanup empty/deadline/errors and end/errors checked separately; outer rc must be exact LF bytes; pytest rc rejects booleans and must be expected integer. A null first_error alone is not used.

GREEN requires 21/6/33/11 test functions, complete unique 71 PASSED set, no FAILED entries in the short summary, no FAILURES header, correct totals/rc, no defined error/interruption markers.

Wrong arguments/step/path relation or preexisting output refuse with 2 before output. Judgment-time exceptions append false judge.exception. Output uses exclusive creation; failed checks produce STOP/1, otherwise MATCH/0. Errors while writing/digesting final output cannot guarantee a judge record; request explicitly stops when record absent/exception, without retry.

Reads judgment bytes and copies only hash/size/verdict/failed IDs, retains missing-read reason, records six copy hashes and both step summaries, exclusive 03_end.json. It cannot turn absent GREEN or STOP into MATCH and does not replace the executor/manual decision.

required_contract_findings.title: Align the documented anywhere-stdout unexpected-cause rule with RED-only implementation
required_contract_findings.finding: The general reading rules and disclosed strict additions say any stdout occurrence of UNEXPECTED_RED_CAUSE stops. The implementation enforces that rule only in judge_red. judge_green has no marker check.
required_contract_findings.static_counterexample: Consider an otherwise conforming GREEN stdout with an extra non-header line containing only UNEXPECTED_RED_CAUSE before the recognized sections. This does not alter the PASSED set, terminal total, source binding, common metadata, FAILURES-header absence, or ERROR/INTERNALERROR/Interrupted/!!!! marker tests. No GREEN check reads this marker, so its checks remain true. Under the common-scope reading of the written rule, manual judgment must stop while machine verdict can remain MATCH.
required_contract_findings.evidence_method: Control-flow and predicates inspected only. No synthetic file was constructed and no received function or judge was executed.
required_contract_findings.limitation: This is a contract/implementation scope mismatch, not a demonstrated actual fixed GREEN run or proof that normal 71-pass output will contain the marker. The RED-specific repetition at request lines 323–324 makes author intent ambiguous.
required_contract_findings.required_resolution: Author must select and state the rule scope consistently: if RED-only, qualify the general reading rule/disclosure/send text; if both steps, enforce it in common or GREEN logic. Update affected identities and prereview. Do not silently resolve a mismatch during execution.
required_contract_findings.manual_comparison: The stop-on-disagreement rule prevents continuing when the executor notices the disagreement, but it does not make the two specified criteria equivalent.
